definitions.gloss: bonus ticket; privilege coupon; perk voucher
definitions.explanation: A ticket or voucher that entitles the holder to a special benefit, bonus item, or extra service. Often distributed as part of promotions, loyalty programs, or with purchases.

examples.japanese: {特典券|とくてんけん}を{使|つか}って{無料|むりょう}でドリンクをもらった。
examples.english: I got a free drink using a bonus ticket.

examples.japanese: {会員|かいいん}{限定|げんてい}の{特典券|とくてんけん}が{届|とど}いた。
{初回|しょかい}{購入者|こうにゅうしゃ}には{特典券|とくてんけん}がついており、{次回|じかい}の{買|か}い{物|もの}で{割引|わりびき}が{受|う}けられる。
examples.english: First-time purchasers receive a bonus ticket that entitles them to a discount on their next purchase.

notes:
A compound of {特典|とくてん} (special benefit, privilege, bonus) and {券|けん} (ticket, voucher). Common in retail, entertainment, and membership contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {特典券|とくてんけん}を{配布|はいふ}する: to distribute bonus tickets
- {特典券|とくてんけん}を{利用|りよう}する: to use a privilege coupon
- {特典券|とくてんけん}{付|つ}き: with a bonus ticket included
- {来場|らいじょう}{特典券|とくてんけん}: attendance bonus ticket

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {割引券|わりびきけん}: discount coupon — specifically offers a price reduction
- {優待券|ゆうたいけん}: complimentary ticket — a ticket offering preferential treatment, often from shareholding
- {引換券|ひきかえけん}: exchange ticket — a voucher to be redeemed for a specific item
